title: Bowler bag in a blade of red light

tokens.v: She stands side-on in the black void, holding the bowler bag at hip height so the red blade of light falls exactly across the bag and her eyes, everything else in darkness. She wears a black turtleneck, black wide-leg trousers and black pointed ankle boots. 50mm, framed from the knees up, the red light saturated and the shadows true black.
